title: Permutation Sum
statementMd:
***Permutation** $*p*$ is an ordered set of integers $*p*_{1},  *p*_{2},  ...,  *p*_{*n*}$, consisting of $*n*$ distinct positive integers, each of them doesn't exceed $*n*$. We'll denote the $*i*$-th element of permutation $*p*$ as $*p*_{*i*}$. We'll call number $*n*$ the size or the length of permutation $*p*_{1},  *p*_{2},  ...,  *p*_{*n*}$.*

Petya decided to introduce the sum operation on the set of permutations of length $*n*$. Let's assume that we are given two permutations of length $*n*$: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ and $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$. Petya calls the sum of permutations $*a*$ and $*b*$ such permutation $*c*$ of length $*n*$, where $*c*_{*i*} = ((*a*_{*i*} - 1 + *b*_{*i*} - 1) *mod* *n*) + 1$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*)$.

Operation ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d533a6df05afe2c303e325bb11b740c58acf6da.png) means taking the remainder after dividing number $*x*$ by number $*y*$.

Obviously, not for all permutations $*a*$ and $*b*$ exists permutation $*c*$ that is sum of $*a*$ and $*b*$. That's why Petya got sad and asked you to do the following: given $*n*$, count the number of such pairs of permutations $*a*$ and $*b*$ of length $*n*$, that exists permutation $*c*$ that is sum of $*a*$ and $*b*$. The pair of permutations $*x*, *y*$ $(*x* ≠ *y*)$ and the pair of permutations $*y*, *x*$ are considered distinct pairs.

As the answer can be rather large, print the remainder after dividing it by $1000000007$ ($10^{9} + 7$).

## Input

The single line contains integer $*n* (1 ≤ *n* ≤ 16)$.

## Output

In the single line print a single non-negative integer — the number of such pairs of permutations $*a*$ and $*b*$, that exists permutation $*c*$ that is sum of $*a*$ and $*b*$, modulo $1000000007$ ($10^{9} + 7$).
statementZhMd:
***排列** $*p*$ 是一个整数有序序列 $*p*_{1},  *p*_{2},  ...,  *p*_{*n*}$，由 $*n*$ 个互不相同的正整数组成，且每个数都不超过 $*n*$。我们将排列 $*p*$ 的第 $*i*$ 个元素记为 $*p*_{*i*}$。我们称数字 $*n*$ 为排列 $*p*_{1},  *p*_{2},  ...,  *p*_{*n*}$ 的大小或长度。*

Petya 决定在长度为 $*n*$ 的排列集合上定义求和运算。假设给定两个长度为 $*n*$ 的排列：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 和 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$。Petya 将排列 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 的和定义为一个长度为 $*n*$ 的排列 $*c*$，其中 $*c*_{*i*} = ((*a*_{*i*} - 1 + *b*_{*i*} - 1) *mod* *n*) + 1$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*)$。

运算 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d533a6df05afe2c303e325bb11b740c58acf6da.png) 表示数字 $*x*$ 除以数字 $*y*$ 后所得的余数。

显然，并不是对于所有排列 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$，都存在作为它们之和的排列 $*c*$。因此 Petya 很苦恼，并请求你完成以下任务：给定 $*n*$，计算满足存在排列 $*c*$，且 $*c*$ 是排列 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 之和的长度为 $*n*$ 的排列对 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 的数量。排列对 $*x*, *y*$（$*x* ≠ *y*$）与排列对 $*y*, *x*$ 被视为不同的排列对。

由于答案可能很大，请输出答案除以 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）所得的余数。

## 输入格式

一行包含一个整数 $*n* (1 ≤ *n* ≤ 16)$。

## 输出格式

一行输出一个非负整数——满足存在排列 $*c*$，且 $*c*$ 是排列 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 之和的长度为 $*n*$ 的排列对 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 的数量，结果对 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模。
